final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY cu.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT c.gender, c.order_count, c.order_count - a.avg_count AS diff_above_avg FROM c, a WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_count
